summary: Pattern operators are processed in order: : and , first, then &, then !, so their position in the string doesn't change the result.
questions: Does the order of & and ! in a pattern matter?
How does Ansible evaluate complex host patterns?

answer_card.title: Pattern processing order
answer_card.answer_md:
Processing order: 1) `:` and `,`, 2) `&`, 3) `!`.

So `a:b:&c:!d:!e`, `&c:a:!d:b:!e` and `!d:a:!e:&c:b` are all: in (a or b) AND in c AND not in d or e.
